reason: The plugin’s primary user-facing purpose is a workspace file navigation and preview sidebar in DSH. Evidence shows it provides a docked file panel with directory browsing, multi-format file previewing, and session-produced file listing, while also enabling drag-and-drop insertion of file/folder paths into the chat input. Core behavior is UI- and workspace-focused with limited stated capabilities centered on browsing and reading workspace file content.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DSH 的文件侧边栏插件，提供工作区文件浏览与多种格式预览，并可将会话中产出/修改的文件列出后快速预览或通过拖拽将文件路径插入对话。
summaries.en: This is a DSH plugin that adds a sidebar for browsing workspace files, previews common formats, shows session-produced/modified files, and lets users drag files or folders into the conversation as path text.

capabilities: Reads and lists files from registered workspaces via host routes
Renders multiple preview formats (Markdown, PDF, images, CSV, code text) in the UI panel
Parses session event logs to surface files marked as produced/modified in the current session
Supports drag-and-drop of files/folders into the conversation as plain path text
